summary: Iter10 — Verified all 4 fix TCs (TC_PROJECTS_001, FINANCE_001/002/003) plus regressions. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (expense-categories list/create/duplicate-409/rename+propagation; project finance summary revenue_last_year/cost_last_year/period_from/period_to; regressions on org dashboard-summary, projects list, project invoices). Frontend: admin login OK; New Project modal shows both manual project-location-input and detect-location-button — detect falls back to raw coordinates '12.9700, 77.5900' because Nominatim is CORS-blocked from the preview origin (expected fallback per note); Project Finance page shows 'REVENUE FROM CLIENT' ₹4.00 Cr with pf-income-period '1 year · 2025-08-10 → 2026-08-10' and 'EXPENSE' ₹9.03 Cr with same pf-cost-period; expense-categories-panel lists 11 rows (8 seed + prior TEST_ leftovers), add via new-category-add works (11→12), rename via window.prompt propagates in UI, expense-category-select dropdown is present in expense form.

minor.issue: Not implemented (405). Test-created categories cannot be cleaned up; residual TEST_* rows accumulate across runs.

integration_issues.issue: Nominatim reverse geocode blocked by CORS from preview origin (net::ERR_FAILED). Frontend gracefully falls back to raw 'lat, lon' string — functional but user sees coordinates instead of a place name. Consider proxying Nominatim via backend to get human-readable city.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby (a11y console warnings)
Recharts container width/height=-1 warnings (chart parent has 0 dim during initial mount)

action_items: (Optional) Implement DELETE /api/expense-categories/{id} so tests / users can clean up added categories (currently 405).
(Optional) Proxy Nominatim through backend to bypass browser CORS so detect-location returns a place name instead of raw coordinates.
(Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent instances.
critical_code_review_comments: expense-categories PATCH correctly propagates rename to Expense rows (verified via API test).
project_finance summary correctly exposes revenue_last_year, cost_last_year, period_from, period_to (365-day window).
No sensitive info leaked; JWT via httpOnly cookies + Authorization fallback both work.
seed_data_creation: Test created two TEST_ITER10_* expense categories and one TEST_UI_<ts>[_R] category via UI. Cannot be deleted (no DELETE endpoint) — leftover rows present but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: expense-categories has no DELETE — accumulating TEST_* rows are expected. Nominatim is CORS-blocked from preview origin; detect-location falls back to raw lat/lon which is still a pass per the request. Use unique category names per run.
